name: Dispatcharr Stream Sort
description: Analyzes stream health and quality, scores candidate streams, and reorders streams already assigned to Dispatcharr channels.
author: matrix2669

fields.label: Sorting model
fields.description: Stream Sort now includes its own checker. Known-dead/stale streams are demoted first. Resolution remains a hard tier; bitrate, frame rate, M3U source, name rules, and cached delivery throughput score streams inside a tier.

fields.label: Channel scope
fields.description: Optional group/profile filters limit every Analyze, Dry Run, Sort, and Throughput action. Multiple values inside one filter are ORed; when both filters are set, a channel must match both.

fields.label: Channel group filter
fields.help_text: Optional exact Dispatcharr channel group names or IDs, separated by commas or new lines. Examples: Local, id:4. Empty means all groups. Uses the channel's effective group, including overrides.

fields.label: Channel profile filter
fields.help_text: Optional exact Dispatcharr channel profile names or IDs, separated by commas or new lines. Only enabled profile memberships are included. Empty means all profiles/channels.

fields.label: M3U source scores
fields.help_text: Legacy fallback. When the plugin is enabled this is replaced by one numeric score box per configured M3U account.

fields.label: Stream name scoring rules
fields.default:
# Prefix=score. Prefix rules are case-insensitive and anchored to the start of the stream name.
US=20
GO=10
TUBI=0
PRIME=-10
ROKU=-20
fields.help_text: PREFIX=score creates a case-insensitive anchored prefix rule. Advanced regex uses score::regex. All matching name rules are additive.

fields.label: Built-in stream analyzer
fields.description: Analyze Streams replaces the IPTV Checker dependency for sorting. It checks reachability, resolution, FPS, codecs, measured video bitrate, fixed-duration placeholder files, black video, frozen video, and silent audio. Rate-limited/audio-only/Streamlink-only sources are skipped rather than marked dead. It never renames, moves, creates, or deletes channels.

fields.label: Analysis workers
fields.help_text: Number of streams analyzed in parallel. Keep this conservative if a provider limits simultaneous connections.

fields.label: FFprobe sample duration (seconds)
fields.help_text: Packet sample used for bitrate and metadata analysis.

fields.label: Retries for transient failures
fields.help_text: Retries timeouts, connection-refused, network-unreachable and server-error results after the first pass.

fields.label: Per-source analysis start delay (seconds)
fields.help_text: Minimum delay between starting checks against the same M3U account.

fields.label: Maximum streams per analysis run
fields.help_text: 0 means all unique streams attached to channels inside the selected scope. Useful for controlled dev-test runs.

fields.label: Detect fixed-duration placeholder files
fields.help_text: A continuous live stream normally has no fixed container duration. This check adds no extra provider connection.

fields.label: Detect silent audio
fields.help_text: Only applies when an audio track exists.

fields.label: Content-check sample duration (seconds)
fields.help_text: Black/frozen/silent checks share one FFmpeg decode pass.

fields.label: Delivery throughput scoring
fields.description: Throughput remains a separate delivery-health measurement. Run Probe Throughput when you want fresh delivery scores; known-dead streams from the built-in analyzer are skipped.

fields.label: Throughput cache TTL (minutes)
fields.help_text: Expired throughput probes become UNKNOWN and stop affecting score.

fields.label: Maximum throughput probes per minute
fields.help_text: Global start-rate cap used to limit provider load.

fields.label: Maximum streams per throughput run
fields.help_text: 0 means all unique non-dead streams attached to channels inside the selected scope.

actions.label: Analyze Streams
actions.description: Run the built-in stream checker for unique streams in the selected channel scope and update Dispatcharr stream metadata.

confirm.title: Analyze assigned streams?
confirm.message: This opens provider stream connections and may decode short samples for black/frozen/silent detection. It does not rename, move, create, or delete channels.

actions.label: Dry Run
actions.description: Calculate the proposed order for the selected channel scope without changing ChannelStream.order.

actions.label: Sort Streams
actions.description: Apply the calculated order to streams already assigned to channels inside the selected scope.

confirm.title: Apply stream ordering?
confirm.message: This changes ChannelStream.order only for the selected channel scope. It does not add or remove streams.

actions.label: Analyze + Sort
actions.description: Run the built-in checker, then apply stream ordering using the refreshed health/metadata and any current throughput cache.

confirm.title: Analyze and sort streams?
confirm.message: This analyzes provider streams and then changes ChannelStream.order. It does not rename, move, create, or delete channels.

actions.label: Probe Throughput
actions.description: Start a background delivery-throughput probe for non-dead unique streams in the selected channel scope.

confirm.title: Probe assigned streams?
confirm.message: This opens provider stream connections for streams attached to channels inside the selected scope.

actions.label: Probe + Sort
actions.description: Probe delivery throughput, then apply ordering when probing completes.

confirm.title: Probe and sort streams?
confirm.message: This probes provider streams and then changes ChannelStream.order.
